usedFor: Tor onion services use HiddenServiceDir and HiddenServicePort to map an onion virtual port to a local target.
The hostname file contains the onion v3 address.
The other files in HiddenServiceDir are onion service keys and must remain private.
Privacy Pass requires Client, Origin, Issuer, and Attester roles.
Token issuance and redemption contexts must be separated for privacy.
Redeemed tokens must not be replayed.
PrivateToken is the HTTP authentication scheme for Privacy Pass token challenges and redemption.
Clients can cache tokens to separate issuance time from redemption time.
Cached tokens must match challenge fields and replay controls.

modeDecision.reason: Tor onion ingress needs one reviewed onion service deployment, onion host fingerprint, reverse-proxy redaction review, no-IP retention review, and reviewer acceptance. Blinded-token transport also needs issuer, verifier, token-family, replay-cache, issuance/redemption separation, and replay/hoarding review.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: refs-only Tor onion service deployment ref, onion-service ref, and onion host fingerprint ref
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Not satisfied by a local template or direct HTTP relayer health check.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: refs-only review proving reverse-proxy and relayer logs omit or redact IP headers, user agents, auth tokens, proof/witness/private-input material, wallet identifiers, and raw tokens
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Not satisfied by source code alone; reviewer must inspect deployed ingress and relayer log surfaces.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: refs-only retention-policy ref that explicitly forbids open-ended persistence of IP addresses, forwarded headers, user agents, auth tokens, and raw token material
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Not a legal/compliance claim; it is the minimum operational retention control before transport refs can be accepted.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: refs-only reviewer acceptance ref binding deployment, log-redaction, retention, mode-specific refs, and forbidden-material review
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Not satisfied by the operator who created the local request packet.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: filled reviewed refs-only JSON matching exactly one mode
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Passing validation permits provider env review; it still does not lift productionReady or privacyClaimAllowed.

reviewOrder.requiredReturn: Render env names set to refs-only values, followed by live env-status --require-ready readback
reviewOrder.truthBoundary: Do not set placeholder refs or raw secret values on Render.

truthBoundary: This packet tells an operator and reviewer exactly how to obtain reviewed refs-only Tor-onion or blinded-token privacy-transport evidence. It does not deploy Tor, deploy a blinded-token issuer/verifier, accept reviewer refs, mutate Render envs, prove anonymity, lift production privacy, sign, broadcast, or move funds.
